pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(piano instrumental, warm and gentle atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
Morning light across your face
like the day the sun found you
and somehow my quiet heart
learned the warmth it never knew

Your small laugh in the air
the tremble in your hand
every little moment feels
like a miracle I can understand

[Chorus]
Every hour with you beside me
flows like quiet happiness
days keep shining a little brighter
in your soft tenderness

The world slowly changes colors
every step we take together
this small moment in my memory
I will hold forever

[Verse 2]
Underneath the silver night
the stars rest above our eyes
in the reflection of your gaze
I can see my own light rise

We don't need to say a word
the silence already knows
two quiet hearts discovering
the same gentle road

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo)

[Bridge]
A soft wind passes slowly
carrying your breath to me
in that calm and simple second
I become who I can be

If time decided to pause right here
I would never ask for more
in the warmth of your embrace
I have everything I'm living for

[Chorus]
Every hour with you beside me
flows like quiet happiness
dreaming softly in your arms
in a peaceful tenderness

The world slowly fades around us
nothing else I need to see
in the quiet light between us
you are everything to me

[Outro]
(piano outro, emotional and peaceful fade)
